title: Perfect hold
text: Perfect hold. Oh where have these been all this time? I absolutly love these! I have very heavy drapes in my living room that have regular tie backs that are nailed to the wall..works good for the end drapes but not the center sections. When I first got these I wasnt sure that the magnets would be strong enough...but thankfully, I was wrong. I decided to test them, first one went on a single piece and the magnet grabbed the other one right away. Then I tried it with 2 (heavy) panels..and put it higher up and it grabbed that just as easy! Best part is they dont slide down the material. These are the best ever!!! I got the yellow and my drapes are gold..they match perfectly.

product_metadata.title: MXCELL Yellow Magnetic Curtain Tiebacks Clips Holders for Office and Home or Sheer Windows Draperies 6 Pcs
